text: The Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) operates a portfolio of 156 City-owned off-street parking facilities. Utilization data from these assets is a critical input for evidence-based decision-making and supports the City's commitment to transparency and accountability. In June 2025, City Council requested (via MM 31.6) the Toronto Parking Authority to begin publishing utilization data on a quarterly basis via the City of Toronto's Open Data Portal. This report provides Management's response, outlining the data to be published and the timelines for implementation.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Received the report (October 1, 2025) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, for information.
